mentions.name: Reportr
mentions.description: An AI client for data analysis that connects to databases via MCP servers and displays large volumes of data, addressing the limitation of using Claude desktop as a database client.
mentions.problem: Claude desktop can connect to databases via MCP servers but is not great at displaying large volumes of data; a custom client can do a much better job.
mentions.source_excerpt:
AI client for data analysis.

You can connect Claude desktop to databases using MCP servers, but Claude desktop is not great at displaying large volumes of data. A custom client can do a much better job.

https://reportr.com/
mentions.author: sandhya6
